-- P5 PC7 append-only authority runtime schema, schema version 1 -> 2.
-- HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED/APPLIED rows require daemon-authenticated owner_peer_uid;
-- application code must bind :authenticated_peer_uid from SO_PEERCRED.
CREATE TABLE authority_proposals (
  proposal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  family_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  run_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(run_class='STATISTICAL_TRIAL'),
  binding_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(binding_sha256)=64),
  binding_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(binding_json)),
  producer_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(run_id, binding_sha256)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE authority_transitions (
  transition_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_proposals(proposal_id),
  from_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(from_state IN ('NONE','PROPOSED','PRECONDITIONS_PASS','HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED')),
  to_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(to_state IN ('PROPOSED','PRECONDITIONS_PASS','HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED','APPLIED')),
  daemon_recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  daemon_ledger_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
  immutable_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  authenticated_peer_uid INTEGER NOT NULL,
  event_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(event_sha256)=64),
  UNIQUE(proposal_id, daemon_ledger_sequence)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE logical_trials (
  logical_trial_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  grant_proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_proposals(proposal_id),
  candidate_list_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(candidate_list_sha256)=64),
  UNIQUE(grant_proposal_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE trial_attempts (
  attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  logical_trial_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES logical_trials(logical_trial_id),
  attempt_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt_ordinal>=1),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('RUNNING','ATTEMPT_VOID','COMPLETED')),
  checkpoint_sha256 TEXT CHECK(checkpoint_sha256 IS NULL OR length(checkpoint_sha256)=64),
  UNIQUE(logical_trial_id, attempt_ordinal)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE owner_conditional_delegations (
  delegation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  owner_identity TEXT NOT NULL,
  owner_credential_scheme TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(owner_credential_scheme='ED25519'),
  unsigned_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(unsigned_payload_json)),
  owner_signature_b64 TEXT NOT NULL,
  owner_signature_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(owner_signature_sha256)=64),
  owner_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(scope_sha256)=64),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('ACTIVE','OWNER_DELEGATION_REVOKED'))
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE delegation_redemptions (
  redemption_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  delegation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES owner_conditional_delegations(delegation_id),
  child_proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_proposals(proposal_id),
  preconditions_transition_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_transitions(transition_id),
  human_owner_signed_transition_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_transitions(transition_id),
  scope_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(scope_sha256)=64),
  UNIQUE(delegation_id,child_proposal_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE owner_delegation_revocations (
  revocation_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  delegation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES owner_conditional_delegations(delegation_id),
  daemon_recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  daemon_ledger_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
  authenticated_owner_uid INTEGER NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(delegation_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE amendment_registrations (
  amendment_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  amendment_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(amendment_id IN ('C','A','B')),
  amendment_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(amendment_sha256)=64),
  registration_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(registration_ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
  authorization_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(authorization_mode IN ('INTERACTIVE_OWNER_SIGN','PREAUTHORIZED_CONDITIONAL_DELEGATION')),
  delegation_id TEXT REFERENCES owner_conditional_delegations(delegation_id),
  daemon_recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(amendment_id), UNIQUE(registration_ordinal)
) STRICT;

CREATE TRIGGER delegation_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON owner_conditional_delegations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'delegation rows are immutable; revoke by event'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER delegation_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON owner_conditional_delegations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'delegation rows are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER delegation_revocation_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON owner_delegation_revocations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'revocation events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER delegation_revocation_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON owner_delegation_revocations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'revocation events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER amendment_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON amendment_registrations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'amendment registrations are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER amendment_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON amendment_registrations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'amendment registrations are append-only'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER authority_transition_order BEFORE INSERT ON authority_transitions
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN NEW.to_state='PROPOSED' AND NEW.from_state!='NONE' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal authority transition')
    WHEN NEW.to_state='PRECONDITIONS_PASS' AND NEW.from_state!='PROPOSED' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal authority transition')
    WHEN NEW.to_state='HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED' AND NEW.from_state!='PRECONDITIONS_PASS' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal authority transition')
    WHEN NEW.to_state='APPLIED' AND NEW.from_state!='HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal authority transition')
  END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER authority_transitions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON authority_transitions
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'authority transitions are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER authority_transitions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON authority_transitions
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'authority transitions are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER logical_trials_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON logical_trials
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'logical trials are immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER logical_trials_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON logical_trials
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'logical trials are immutable'); END;

-- P5 PC7 direct-repair authority schema, schema version 2 -> 3.
-- Suggested draft.  Freeze the sha256 and pass staging/rehearsal dry-run
-- before any real execution (ops-path v2->v3 report section 2/3).
--
-- Scope of this draft:
--   1. Amendment ceremony becomes C -> D -> A -> B:
--      registration ordinals 1..2 are direct owner-signed (C, D),
--      ordinals 3..4 are preauthorized delegation-registered (A, B).
--      A BEFORE INSERT trigger pins the fixed order and UNIQUE
--      (registration_ordinal) pins the sequence.
--   2. Resource hashes: resource_policy_sha256 is added to
--      authority_proposals, authority_transitions,
--      owner_conditional_delegations and delegation_redemptions
--      (Amendment D Wave-1 resource-policy binding).  Legacy rows keep
--      NULL; production v2 has zero authority rows.
--   3. Append-only triggers are completed: authority_proposals,
--      delegation_redemptions and trial_attempts gain no-update /
--      no-delete triggers; triggers on rebuilt tables are recreated.
--   4. run_class CHECK is widened per Amendment C to
--      ('STATISTICAL_TRIAL','SYNTHETIC_TEST'), the direct-repair
--      authority runtime wordlist.
--
-- Explicitly out of scope (ops-path report section 2 option b):
-- rebuilding agent_runs / audit_events / migration_audit workload /
-- authority CHECK supersets, the verify() relaxation, and the app-side
-- research_db.SCHEMA_VERSION=3 sync.
--
-- Harness contract (research_db.migrate): executes inside BEGIN EXCLUSIVE
-- with PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; no conditional CREATE clauses; the
-- schema_meta bump below is idempotent with the harness bump.
--
-- Suggested migration_id (must be absent from migration_audit):
--   p5-pc7-direct-repair-amendments-v1
--
-- Fail-closed note: legacy amendment rows are re-inserted through the new
-- order trigger, so any v2 database whose amendment sequence is not
-- already C(1) D(2) A(3) B(4)-compatible aborts the migration instead of
-- guessing.  Production v2 has zero authority rows; this only affects
-- disposable rehearsal databases.

-- 1. Snapshot the authority tables that must be rebuilt.  Table-swap is
--    required because SQLite cannot alter CHECK constraints in place and
--    ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN cannot add a NOT NULL column without a
--    default.  Children are dropped before parents and recreated after
--    them so PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON stays satisfied inside the harness
--    transaction (deferred FK enforcement does NOT help DROP TABLE).
CREATE TABLE _bak_authority_proposals AS SELECT * FROM authority_proposals;
CREATE TABLE _bak_authority_transitions AS SELECT * FROM authority_transitions;
CREATE TABLE _bak_logical_trials AS SELECT * FROM logical_trials;
CREATE TABLE _bak_trial_attempts AS SELECT * FROM trial_attempts;
CREATE TABLE _bak_delegation_redemptions AS SELECT * FROM delegation_redemptions;
CREATE TABLE _bak_amendment_registrations AS SELECT * FROM amendment_registrations;

-- 2. Drop leaves first, then parents.
DROP TABLE trial_attempts;
DROP TABLE delegation_redemptions;
DROP TABLE authority_transitions;
DROP TABLE logical_trials;
DROP TABLE amendment_registrations;
DROP TABLE authority_proposals;

-- 3. Recreate parents first, then children, with the v3 shape.
CREATE TABLE authority_proposals (
  proposal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  family_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  run_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(run_class IN ('STATISTICAL_TRIAL','SYNTHETIC_TEST')),
  binding_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(binding_sha256)=64),
  binding_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(binding_json)),
  producer_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  resource_policy_sha256 TEXT CHECK(resource_policy_sha256 IS NULL OR length(resource_policy_sha256)=64),
  UNIQUE(run_id, binding_sha256)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE authority_transitions (
  transition_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_proposals(proposal_id),
  from_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(from_state IN ('NONE','PROPOSED','PRECONDITIONS_PASS','HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED')),
  to_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(to_state IN ('PROPOSED','PRECONDITIONS_PASS','HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED','APPLIED')),
  daemon_recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  daemon_ledger_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
  immutable_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  authenticated_peer_uid INTEGER NOT NULL,
  event_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(event_sha256)=64),
  resource_policy_sha256 TEXT CHECK(resource_policy_sha256 IS NULL OR length(resource_policy_sha256)=64),
  UNIQUE(proposal_id, daemon_ledger_sequence)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE logical_trials (
  logical_trial_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  grant_proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_proposals(proposal_id),
  candidate_list_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(candidate_list_sha256)=64),
  UNIQUE(grant_proposal_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE trial_attempts (
  attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  logical_trial_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES logical_trials(logical_trial_id),
  attempt_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt_ordinal>=1),
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('RUNNING','ATTEMPT_VOID','COMPLETED')),
  checkpoint_sha256 TEXT CHECK(checkpoint_sha256 IS NULL OR length(checkpoint_sha256)=64),
  UNIQUE(logical_trial_id, attempt_ordinal)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE delegation_redemptions (
  redemption_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  delegation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES owner_conditional_delegations(delegation_id),
  child_proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_proposals(proposal_id),
  preconditions_transition_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_transitions(transition_id),
  human_owner_signed_transition_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES authority_transitions(transition_id),
  scope_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(scope_sha256)=64),
  resource_policy_sha256 TEXT CHECK(resource_policy_sha256 IS NULL OR length(resource_policy_sha256)=64),
  UNIQUE(delegation_id,child_proposal_id)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE amendment_registrations (
  amendment_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  amendment_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(amendment_id IN ('C','D','A','B')),
  amendment_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(amendment_sha256)=64),
  registration_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(registration_ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 4),
  authorization_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(authorization_mode IN ('INTERACTIVE_OWNER_SIGN','PREAUTHORIZED_CONDITIONAL_DELEGATION')),
  delegation_id TEXT REFERENCES owner_conditional_delegations(delegation_id),
  daemon_recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  producer_session_id TEXT,
  owner_session_id TEXT,
  UNIQUE(amendment_id),
  UNIQUE(registration_ordinal),
  CHECK ((authorization_mode='INTERACTIVE_OWNER_SIGN' AND delegation_id IS NULL)
      OR (authorization_mode='PREAUTHORIZED_CONDITIONAL_DELEGATION' AND delegation_id IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK ((producer_session_id IS NULL AND owner_session_id IS NULL)
      OR (producer_session_id IS NOT NULL AND owner_session_id IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT;

-- 4. Owner delegations are not rebuilt; the resource hash is appended.
ALTER TABLE owner_conditional_delegations ADD COLUMN resource_policy_sha256 TEXT CHECK(resource_policy_sha256 IS NULL OR length(resource_policy_sha256)=64);

-- 5. Recreate triggers that were dropped with the rebuilt tables, then add
--    the new append-only and ordering triggers.
CREATE TRIGGER authority_transition_order BEFORE INSERT ON authority_transitions
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN NEW.to_state='PROPOSED' AND NEW.from_state!='NONE' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal authority transition')
    WHEN NEW.to_state='PRECONDITIONS_PASS' AND NEW.from_state!='PROPOSED' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal authority transition')
    WHEN NEW.to_state='HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED' AND NEW.from_state!='PRECONDITIONS_PASS' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal authority transition')
    WHEN NEW.to_state='APPLIED' AND NEW.from_state!='HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal authority transition')
  END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER authority_transitions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON authority_transitions
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'authority transitions are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER authority_transitions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON authority_transitions
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'authority transitions are append-only'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER logical_trials_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON logical_trials
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'logical trials are immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER logical_trials_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON logical_trials
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'logical trials are immutable'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER amendment_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON amendment_registrations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'amendment registrations are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER amendment_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON amendment_registrations
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'amendment registrations are append-only'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER amendment_order BEFORE INSERT ON amendment_registrations
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN NEW.registration_ordinal=1 AND NEW.amendment_id!='C' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'amendment 1 must be C (direct owner sign)')
    WHEN NEW.registration_ordinal=2 AND NEW.amendment_id!='D' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'amendment 2 must be D (direct owner sign)')
    WHEN NEW.registration_ordinal=3 AND NEW.amendment_id!='A' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'amendment 3 must be A (delegated)')
    WHEN NEW.registration_ordinal=4 AND NEW.amendment_id!='B' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'amendment 4 must be B (delegated)')
    WHEN NEW.registration_ordinal>1 AND NOT EXISTS(
         SELECT 1 FROM amendment_registrations WHERE registration_ordinal=NEW.registration_ordinal-1)
      THEN RAISE(ABORT,'amendment registration order violation')
  END;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER authority_proposals_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON authority_proposals
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'authority proposals are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER authority_proposals_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON authority_proposals
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'authority proposals are append-only'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER delegation_redemptions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON delegation_redemptions
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'delegation redemptions are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER delegation_redemptions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON delegation_redemptions
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'delegation redemptions are append-only'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER trial_attempts_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON trial_attempts
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'trial attempts are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER trial_attempts_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON trial_attempts
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'trial attempts are append-only'); END;

-- 6. Restore rows (parents first).  New columns are NULL for legacy rows;
--    restored rows pass through the same CHECK/order/FSM triggers as new
--    rows, so any nonconforming v2 state fails closed here.
INSERT INTO authority_proposals
  SELECT proposal_id,family_id,run_id,run_class,binding_sha256,binding_json,
         producer_session_id,expires_at,created_at,NULL
  FROM _bak_authority_proposals;

INSERT INTO authority_transitions
  SELECT transition_id,proposal_id,from_state,to_state,daemon_recorded_at,
         daemon_ledger_sequence,immutable_session_id,authenticated_peer_uid,
         event_sha256,NULL
  FROM _bak_authority_transitions;

INSERT INTO logical_trials SELECT * FROM _bak_logical_trials;
INSERT INTO trial_attempts SELECT * FROM _bak_trial_attempts;

INSERT INTO delegation_redemptions
  SELECT redemption_event_id,delegation_id,child_proposal_id,
         preconditions_transition_id,human_owner_signed_transition_id,
         scope_sha256,NULL
  FROM _bak_delegation_redemptions;

INSERT INTO amendment_registrations
  SELECT amendment_event_id,amendment_id,amendment_sha256,registration_ordinal,
         authorization_mode,delegation_id,daemon_recorded_at,NULL,NULL
  FROM _bak_amendment_registrations;

-- 7. Drop the snapshots.
DROP TABLE _bak_amendment_registrations;
DROP TABLE _bak_delegation_redemptions;
DROP TABLE _bak_trial_attempts;
DROP TABLE _bak_logical_trials;
DROP TABLE _bak_authority_transitions;
DROP TABLE _bak_authority_proposals;

-- 8. Version bump (idempotent with the harness bump).
UPDATE schema_meta SET schema_version=3 WHERE singleton=1 AND schema_version=2;

# AmendmentApplied 状态机：单行不足，需补事件表

## 结论

**不够。** `amendment_registrations` 单行（无论 7 列 schema v2，还是当前 repair-stage 代码里硬编码 `state='APPLIED'` 的 12 列 INSERT）只是"一次性登记即终态"的记录，**不是** PROPOSED→PRECONDITIONS_PASS→HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED→APPLIED 状态机：无中间态、无机前条件证据、无独立 HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED/APPLIED 事件、无账本序/事件哈希链。当前修复波次把"注册"与"APPLIED"压缩成一次 INSERT，直接违反 canonical 条款。

## 证据（当前时点 12:54，文件正被并行修改）

| 事实 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| v2 schema 无 state 列，`amendment_id IN ('C','A','B')`、ordinal 1..3，且 no_update/no_delete 触发器禁止演进 | [P5_STATISTICAL_EXECUTION_LAYER_SCHEMA_MIGRATION_V1.sql](E:/VPS/pc7_stage/P5_STATISTICAL_EXECUTION_LAYER_SCHEMA_MIGRATION_V1.sql:78) |
| 委派路径（A/B）一次 INSERT 直接写 `state='APPLIED'`，无 PRECONDITIONS_PASS、无 HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED 事件 | [authority_store.py](E:/VPS/direct_repair_stage/authority_store.py:163) |
| 直接路径（C/D）同样一次 INSERT 落 `APPLIED`（仅查 owner uid + session 分离 + hash 格式） | [authority_store.py](E:/VPS/direct_repair_stage/authority_store.py:184) |
| `register_delegation` 门禁把"行存在且 state='APPLIED'"当作"C/D 已被 owner 直接 APPLIED" | [authority_store.py](E:/VPS/direct_repair_stage/authority_store.py:102) |
| proposal 有完整 FSM 与事件表，amendment 无任何对应物 | [authority_runtime.py](E:/VPS/direct_repair_stage/authority_runtime.py:17)、[authority_store.py](E:/VPS/direct_repair_stage/authority_store.py:129) |
| 委派 redeem 会产出 HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED 事件（`parent_owner_signature_hash`/`preconditions_event_id`/`redemption_event_id`），但 `register_amendment` 从不走 redeem | [conditional_delegation.py](E:/VPS/direct_repair_stage/conditional_delegation.py:163)、[conditional_delegation.py](E:/VPS/direct_repair_stage/conditional_delegation.py:165) |
| daemon 仅暴露 `amendment-register`，无 amendment 的 preconditions/sign/apply 命令 | [researchctld.py](E:/VPS/direct_repair_stage/app_v2/p5_infra/researchctld.py:85)、[researchctl.py](E:/VPS/direct_repair_stage/app_v2/p5_infra/researchctl.py:102) |
| 波次内的 v3 迁移草稿重建了 C/D/A/B 行，但**没有 state 列也没有 amendment 事件表**——与代码 12 列 INSERT 直接冲突（STRICT 会报 `no column named state`） | [migration.sql](E:/VPS/reports/direct-repair-migration-draft/migration.sql:118) |

## Canonical 条款对照

canonical 文本：`AMENDMENT_C_exact_text.md`（sha256 `5b1d8116…`，远端 `/data/k3/artifacts/p5_empirical_foundation_v1/amendment_packets/`；本地经 compat 记录引用，[build_final_artifacts.py](E:/VPS/pc7_stage/build_final_artifacts.py:25)）：

- **line 7**：`PROPOSED -> PRECONDITIONS_PASS -> HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED -> APPLIED; no agent self-grant; session separation`。单行硬编码 APPLIED 跳过了全部中间态，且委派路径没有"赎回预签凭证才产出 HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED"这一事件语义。
- **line 9**：machine preconditions 必须验证 artifacts/evaluator/amendments/data，**human sign-off 不能替代**。单行里没有任何机检证据字段（matrix/verdict hash），直接路径只验 uid 与 session，等于用 owner 动作替代了机器前件。
- 实施 handoff：无跳过迁移、无追溯签名、agent 不得自授（credential 层强制）；daemon 权威时间 + 追加账本序 + 不可变 session 分离。单行只有一个 `daemon_recorded_at`、无全局唯一账本序、无事件哈希，三者都无法证明。
- 配套文档（signable packets / P1 precondition）：每个 amendment 独立处于 "state PROPOSED prepared-not-signed"，C 先 APPLIED、A 次之、B 最后；"C/A/B PROPOSED not APPLIED；owner authority PENDING"。即**每个 amendment 自身有生命周期**，行存在≠APPLIED。

## 最小建模方案（schema + runtime）

**原则**：`amendment_registrations` 保留为不可变"注册/身份"行（C→D→A→B 顺序、hash、mode 不变），FSM 用一张追加事件表承载——复用已审计的 `authority_proposals`+`authority_transitions` 模式，不发明新机制。

```sql
-- v3 增量：amendment FSM 事件表（append-only）
CREATE TABLE amendment_transitions (
  transition_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  amendment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES amendment_registrations(amendment_id),
  from_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(from_state IN ('NONE','PROPOSED','PRECONDITIONS_PASS','HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED')),
  to_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(to_state IN ('PROPOSED','PRECONDITIONS_PASS','HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED','APPLIED')),
  daemon_recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  daemon_ledger_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  immutable_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  authenticated_peer_uid INTEGER NOT NULL,
  precondition_matrix_sha256 TEXT,   -- PRECONDITIONS_PASS 行必填（line 9 机检证据，逐 amendment pin）
  delegation_id TEXT,                -- 委派模式 HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED 必填
  redemption_event_id TEXT,          -- 指向 DelegationVerifier.redeem() 事件
  event_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(event_sha256)=64),
  UNIQUE(amendment_id, daemon_ledger_sequence)
) STRICT;

CREATE TRIGGER amendment_transition_order BEFORE INSERT ON amendment_transitions
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN NEW.to_state='PROPOSED' AND NEW.from_state!='NONE' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal amendment transition')
    WHEN NEW.to_state='PRECONDITIONS_PASS' AND NEW.from_state!='PROPOSED' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal amendment transition')
    WHEN NEW.to_state='HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED' AND NEW.from_state!='PRECONDITIONS_PASS' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal amendment transition')
    WHEN NEW.to_state='APPLIED' AND NEW.from_state!='HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'illegal amendment transition')
  END;
END;
-- + no_update/no_delete 触发器；建议补 previous_event_sha256 链式列（可选，沿用 pc7-fsm 报告 C2）
```

关键取舍：不要"单行加 state 列"方案——append-only 触发器禁止 UPDATE，要表达 4 个状态就得塞 3~4 组（时间戳/session/peer）列，且机检证据仍需额外表；事件表是最小诚实模型，`当前状态 = SELECT to_state FROM amendment_transitions WHERE amendment_id=? ORDER BY transition_id DESC LIMIT 1`。

**runtime 最小改动**：

1. `register_amendment_direct`（C/D）拆成四步事件：`amendment-propose`（记 PROPOSED + producer session）→ `amendment-preconditions-pass`（携带逐 amendment pin 的 `precondition_matrix_sha256`，机检通过才写）→ `amendment-sign`（owner uid + session 分离，写 HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED）→ `amendment-apply`（写 APPLIED）。不再一次 INSERT 落 `APPLIED`。
2. 委派路径 `register_amendment`（A/B）在 C/D APPLIED 后：写 PROPOSED → PRECONDITIONS_PASS → 调 `DelegationVerifier.redeem()` 产出 HUMAN_OWNER_SIGNED（把 `delegation_id`/`redemption_event_id`/`parent_owner_signature_hash` 写入事件行，对齐 proposal redeem 的 [L129-131](E:/VPS/direct_repair_stage/authority_store.py:129)）→ 独立 APPLIED 步骤。删掉 `state='APPLIED'` 硬编码。
3. `register_delegation` 门禁改为按事件断言：每个 C/D 存在 `to_state='APPLIED'` 的事件且其 PRECONDITIONS_PASS 行有 matrix 证据、APPLIED 行 session/peer 合法（与同波次 RootAfterD 门禁包互补，杜绝只查 amendment_id 字符串）。
